title: End model for limits of rectified diagrams of spaces
statement: Let $J$ be a small ordinary category and $X:J\to\mathrm{sSet}$ a diagram of simplicial sets [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-set]. Set $W_J(j)=N(J/j)$, with transition functors given by postcomposition in the over category. Define $\operatorname{holim}^{\mathrm{end}}_J X=\int_{j\in J}\operatorname{Fun}(W_J(j),X(j))$, the simplicial set of enriched natural transformations from $W_J$ to $X$, with all simplicial degrees retained. For a strict cone with apex $A$ and legs $a_j:A\to X(j)$, its canonical comparison $c:A\to\operatorname{holim}^{\mathrm{end}}_JX$ is characterized by requiring that its $j$th end projection, uncurried on $N(J/j)\times A$, equals $a_j$ after projection to $A$. For Kan-valued diagrams this is the simplicial end model for the limit of spaces in the conventions of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones].

source.place: Section 4.2.4, simplicial diagram models and Proposition 4.2.4.4; the end of the over-category nerve weight is the explicit projectively cofibrant constant-point resolution model used for space limits in the mapping-space descent proof.
